H4609: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H6887: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3201: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1354: the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.
H2790: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
H748: to be (causative, make) long (literally or figuratively)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H5688: something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H5472: properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize)
H268: the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H1406: a roof; by analogy, the top of an altar
H8025: to pull out, up or off
H3001: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H7114: to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain)
H2683: the bosom (as comprised between the arms)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
